verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Intuit publishes an llms.txt at developer.intuit.com (HTTP 200), structured with one section per product and links to follow. It includes payroll-relevant entries such as workers comp code requests, so an agent can be pointed at it. Missing for 10: a payroll-specific llms.txt or agent-oriented doc set (the file is Intuit-wide and leans heavily on Desktop SDK and general QuickBooks content), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
